$comment: GitHub MCP tool map. Several read tools are multiplexed behind a method discriminator — calling them without it fails. The gh CLI is unavailable in web and remote execution environments; use these tools for everything.

taskMap.ci_status_for_sha: actions_list method=list_workflow_runs, then filter by head_sha
taskMap.failing_job_logs: get_job_logs run_id + failed_only:true, then job_id + return_content + tail_lines
taskMap.single_check_run: get_check_run with checkRunId — no list mode exists
taskMap.post_review: pull_request_review_write create, add_comment_to_pending_review xN, pull_request_review_write submit_pending
taskMap.write_files: create_or_update_file for one, push_files for several in one commit

pitfalls: actions_get returns metadata and needs method + resource_id (not run_id) — it is not the log tool
get_check_run fetches one check run by checkRunId and has no list mode
list_workflow_runs can exceed the token limit and be spilled to a file — parse it with node -e, do not read inline
review comments must go through a pending review, submitted once, never posted individually
resolve_review_thread needs the GraphQL thread node id, which goes stale after a force-push
repository scope is enforced — attach a repo with add_repo rather than pre-checking with curl or git ls-remote

contextDiscipline.minimalOutput: pass minimal_output:true when full objects are not needed
contextDiscipline.listVsSearch: list_* for broad enumeration, search_* for targeted criteria
contextDiscipline.sorting: use the separate sort and order parameters — never sort: inside a query string
